customers.evidence: worked to make a difference in our customers' lives in ways that matter most to them

employees.evidence: we bring the powerful backing of American Express to our customers, colleagues and communities

community.evidence: Through our enterprise ESG strategy and Community Giving from the American Express Foundation

result.analyst_notes: Promotional, aspirational newsroom-style page, mostly navigation and teasers. Uses first-person plural ('our customers, colleagues and communities') and leads with customers. Commitments are soft and hedged ('worked to make a difference'), anchored by a heritage claim ('Since 1850'). Most sections are site chrome, so few stakeholder values are actually stated.
